tools.name: list_satellites
tools.description: List the popular satellites (ISS, Tiangong, Hubble and a few others) with each one's orbit data freshness. This is not the full list: every other tool also accepts any NORAD catalog number, e.g. 25544.

tools.name: find_passes
tools.description: List every upcoming pass of one satellite over a location in the next windowHours (default 48, up to 240), in time order. Each pass has rise/peak/set times (UTC, plus riseLocal etc. on the observer's clock), peak elevation, azimuths with compass words (direction), the range at the peak (peakRangeKm)

tools.name: get_position
tools.description: Where a satellite is now, or at a given time: the point on Earth straight below it (latDeg, lonDeg, not where it is in your sky), its altitude, and whether it is sunlit, with url (its page on seeksat.com). tools.description: Cloud-cover forecast (Open-Meteo and MET Norway) and the chance of a clear view for a location at one time, such as a pass's peak. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "best_pass" is 4160 chars, far longer than this server's median (614). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
